reports.title: Bapapili & Boyekoli
reports.subtitle: Bimisa bapapili ya misala
reports.analysis_prod_good: Na tango oyo ebimi, tonnage ekomi {{total}} tonnes. Mosala oyo eza malamu mingi mpe ezolakisa bokende liboso monene koleka sanza eleki. Mosala ezo tambola malamu mpe biloko ebebi eza moke mpenza.
reports.analysis_prod_stable: Na tango oyo ebimi, tonnage ekomi {{total}} tonnes. Tonnage eza ndenge moko mpe ezo kokisa mikano ya mosala. Mosala ezo tambola malamu mpe biloko ebebi eza moke mpenza.
reports.analysis_hse_safe: Na makambo ya bobateli, elongo ya mosala ezui likambo {{incidents}}. Eza esengo ndenge likambo moko te ya makasi esalemi lelo, oyo ezo lakisa botosi ya mibeko ya HSE mpe malamu ya bobateli na biso.
reports.analysis_hse_danger: Na makambo ya bobateli, elongo ya mosala ezui likambo {{incidents}}. Esengeli kotala nokinoki ndenge likambo ya makasi esalemi, mpe esengeli kobakisa bokengeli na mosala.
reports.analysis_finance: Boyekoli ya mbongo elakisi mosala ebiisaki {{expenses}} $. Mbongo esalelami malamu na ndenge ekanamaki na sanza misato oyo. Boyambeli malamu ya biloko esalisi tobeba mbongo ebele te.
reports.analysis_pegs: Bokende liboso ya Pegs elakisi complétion ya {{completionRate}}%. Tango oyo, zones {{active}} eza na exploration to ezo sala. Ndako na bisika ya mosala elandi malamu plan ya bokende liboso ya mine.
